name: Software Merge Workflow
description: Get the pull request into good shape and into the default branch: read the record, bring the branch up to date, make every pre-merge condition true, clear the prerequisites and their order, merge, confirm the default branch is healthy, then finish the follow-ups, hand the person their exact steps and clean up. Moving the ticket into this workflow is the approval to merge.

stages.name: Read the record and set the order
Bring the branch up to date and recheck what came in
Merge and watch the default branch
Clean up and write the merge notes
